messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Breastfeeding:
Tell your healthcare provider if you are breastfeeding or are planning to breastfeed, as it is not known if insulin glargine may harm your breastfeeding baby.

In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'requires use of': The subject drug requires patients to use the specified product or practice to ensure safety or effectiveness.
B. 'has pregnancy or breastfeeding warning': The subject drug carries the warning specified by the object entity regarding use during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
C. 'may require temporary discontinuation before': The subject medication might need to be stopped temporarily prior to undergoing the specified medical procedure.
D. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
